name: Sudden Impact
desc:
👊 Welcome to Sudden Impact! A collaboration of many different beloved characters featured from various shows. 

🎮 Attack your friends and foes alike with our innovative fighting system! Fight to the death until you're the last one standing. 

👍 Make sure to leave us a THUMBS UP and favorite the game for more updates! 

The game is in it's testing stage, and is subject to changes. 

🖥️ Controls
Attack - Left Click
Dash - Q
Unragdoll (Evasive) - Q
Block - F 
Emotes - B

This game is a battlegrounds that includes content inspired from Hazbin Hotel, Invincible, The Boys, and much more.
